posts.text: Here’s the disaster NBA ratings/viewership chart. NFL, CFB, and men’s AND women’s basketball are all setting ratings highs for their signature events and top games. The NBA’s setting multi-decade lows.

Have we all forgotten how many times we were lectured by people saying, “My mask protects you and your mask protects me,” as stewardesses monitored how long we could keep our masks down between sips? Was it all a lie? I thought we all had to mask to stay safe!

To be fair, @SBJ also promises to write fawning articles about everyone in sports if they also buy — wildly overpriced — tickets to all their events. Which most do. I went last year in Nashville. It sucked and was boring. Thinking I should get in the sports conference business.

Gonna put out a video Wednesday to point out that US-Venezuela in the WBC had more viewers than six of the seven NBA Finals games and outrated the series average last year. So you can look forward to that, bud.

No, I, like most people who read me or @outkick, just think anyone wearing a mask at an airport in 2026 doesn’t have a functional brain. But if you think wearing masks makes you safer, shouldn’t you want everyone in masks? Wasn’t that you people’s entire logic during covid?
